body: Air Canada has ordered eight Airbus A350-1000s that will begin to arrive in 2030, ending a decades-long reliance on Boeing 777-300ERs for its long-haul operations. The A350-1000 has a maximum range of 9,000 nautical miles (16,668 km) and will become the airline's flagship, complementing the A321XLRs now joining the fleet. Powered by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines and built around a composite airframe, the A350 is dramatically more efficient than the 777, burning roughly 25% less fuel per seat. Its cabin can be set to a lower 6,000-foot (1,828.8 m) altitude with enhanced humidity controls, reducing jet lag on flights of 17 hours or more.

The order is driven in large part by geopolitics. After Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Canada, the US, the UK and the EU banned Russian aircraft from their skies, and Russia barred NATO-aligned nations from its airspace, cutting off the Siberian corridors that carry the shortest Great-Circle routes between North America and Asia. Air Canada added a fuel stop in London to its Vancouver–Delhi service, turning a 14-hour nonstop journey into two flights of about nine and eight hours with a stop of one to two hours. On existing long routes such as Vancouver–Delhi, the 777 often faces strict weight restrictions that force the airline to leave behind passengers or cargo to carry enough fuel — a limitation the A350 removes.

Air Canada passed on the Boeing 777-9 instead. Its current fleet of 19 Boeing 777s is rapidly aging, with an average age now over 16 years, while the 777-9 program has suffered years of rolling setbacks and testing delays, pushing it to 2027 or later. The 777-9 is a super heavy twinjet with a maximum takeoff weight of 775,000 pounds, and its size works against it on Air Canada's longer routes through Russian airspace compared with the A350. The A350-1000 is also narrower than the 777-300ER — 18 feet, five inches (5.61 m) against 19 feet, three inches (5.87 m) — and carries fewer belly cargo containers, up to about 40 against the 777's 44, a trade-off Air Canada accepted for range and efficiency.
en.summary: Air Canada has ordered eight Airbus A350-1000s, with deliveries starting in 2030, to replace its aging Boeing 777-300ERs on ultra-long-haul routes. The A350's 9,000-nautical-mile range removes the weight restrictions the 777 faces on detoured Asia routes.
en.title: Air Canada orders 8 Airbus A350-1000s to fly nonstop where its Boeing 777-300ERs cannot

body: 加拿大航空訂購8架空中巴士A350-1000，2030年起開始交付，結束長程航線數十年來對波音777-300ER的依賴。A350-1000最大航程9000海里（16668公里），將成為加航旗艦機型，並與陸續加入機隊的A321XLR搭配。A350-1000採用勞斯萊斯Trent XWB-97發動機與複合材料機身，比777省油得多，每座位油耗約低25%；客艙高度可設定在較低的6000英尺（1828.8公尺），濕度控制更佳，有助減輕17小時以上長程航班的時差疲勞。

這筆訂單很大程度由地緣政治推動。2022年2月俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭後，加拿大、美國、英國與歐盟禁止俄羅斯飛機進入其領空，俄羅斯也禁止北約成員國飛機飛越其領空，北美與亞洲之間最短的大圓航路經西伯利亞走廊就此中斷。加航在溫哥華往返德里航線上增加倫敦加油停靠，原本14小時的直飛行程變成約9小時與約8小時的兩段航程，加上1至2小時的停留。在溫哥華往返德里等現有長程航線上，777經常面臨嚴格的載重限制，必須捨棄旅客或貨物才能攜帶足夠燃油，而A350-1000可免除這項限制。

加航因此放棄波音777-9。加航現有19架波音777機隊迅速老化，平均機齡已逾16年，而777-9計畫多年來屢屢延誤與測試受挫，時程已推遲至2027年或更晚。777-9是最大起飛重量達775000磅的超重型雙發動機飛機，在加航須繞行俄羅斯領空的較長航線上，龐大尺寸反而成為劣勢。A350-1000機身也比777-300ER窄，寬18英尺5英寸（5.61公尺），777-300ER為19英尺3英寸（5.87公尺）；腹艙貨櫃容量約40個，低於777的44個，這是加航為航程與效率接受的取捨。
zh.summary: 加拿大航空訂購8架空中巴士A350-1000，2030年起交付，取代機齡漸高的波音777-300ER執飛超長程航線。A350-1000航程9000海里，可免除777在改道亞洲航線上承受的載重限制。
